looking_for.en: Full-stack roles on product teams that own domain-heavy systems end to end, running on Kubernetes. Open to remote or Taiwan-based.

summary.en: Full-stack engineer with a product mindset, building backends in .NET Core or Go and front ends in TypeScript. Committed to Clean Architecture and TDD, working with AI through a self-designed spec-driven development workflow. Delivered scalable solutions across payments, microservices, trading platforms, and cloud-native environments.
